package.json.lint: pnpm -r --if-present lint && pnpm run lint:repo && pnpm run lint:tests && pnpm run lint:test-names
package.json.lint:repo: packages/evry/node_modules/.bin/oxlint -c tools/.oxlintrc.json --max-warnings=0 tools ops scripts .github/scripts .agents/skills tests/support tests/reference/server-trace.test.mjs packages/reference/verify.mjs && node scripts/lint/check-repo-files.mjs && node scripts/lint/check-comments.mjs && node scripts/lint/check-boundaries.mjs
package.json.lint:tests: packages/evry/node_modules/.bin/oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json --max-warnings=0 tests/integration tests/evry tests/ui tests/unit tests/workflow

apps/web/package.json.lint: oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json --max-warnings=0 . && eslint --max-warnings=0 . && node scripts/render-share-images.mjs --check && node scripts/render-mesh-images.mjs --check && node scripts/check-color-literals.mjs && node scripts/check-type-scale.mjs && node scripts/check-corners.mjs
